summary: Today brings a mixed regulatory and market brief driven by strong urban retail growth metrics and fresh high court challenges to regulatory circulars. Legal and corporate strategy teams should track expanding micro-credit data alongside new enterprise tech partnerships involving Reliance Jio.

bullets.text: Urban India achieved 13.1% FMCG growth while traditional trade retained an 80% market share, according to a report by Worldpanel.
A plea filed before the Delhi High Court challenges a Bar Council of India circular prohibiting law students from interning outside vacation periods.
WhatsApp is introducing in-app travel eSIM purchases, partnering with telecom operators including Reliance Jio and Verizon.
India's micro business credit market expanded to Rs 29.6 lakh crore, according to a recent industry report.
Improving customer experience was named top operational priority by 29% of retail CEOs, up from 16% in 2025, a report shows.
